zh.title: 捷藍航空勞德岱堡躍升最大基地：冬季航班較去年增57%，新增8條航線
zh.summary: 捷藍航空南佛羅里達勞德岱堡機場已超越紐約甘迺迪與波士頓，成為該公司起降班次最多的機場；冬季班表期間每日高峰逾150班，為該機場歷來最大規模，並新增8條航線，鎖定精神航空停運後留下的市場。
body: 根據航空分析業者Cirium班表資料，捷藍航空在勞德岱堡—好萊塢國際機場的起降班次，已超越紐約甘迺迪國際機場與波士頓洛根國際機場（BOS），成為該公司最繁忙機場；今年冬季高峰期間，捷藍預計每日營運逾150班，為該機場歷來最大規模。捷藍已排定11月自該機場出發逾3,900班，較去年11月增加約57%；2026/27冬季班表共約21,500班，去年冬季約13,700班，直飛目的地也由47個增至62個。
捷藍近期宣布自勞德岱堡新增每日直飛宏都拉斯科馬亞瓜與開曼群島喬治敦，分別自2027年2月25日與2月23日起飛；科馬亞瓜為捷藍全新目的地，也是該公司在宏都拉斯的第2個航點，兩條航線將使捷藍自勞德岱堡出發的國際航線增至20個目的地。此外，捷藍將自2027年1月29日起，每日直飛千里達及托巴哥西班牙港至2月15日，以因應當地嘉年華需求。

除上述航線外，捷藍今年10月已自勞德岱堡開航哥倫比亞巴蘭基亞與卡利，每日1班；11月新增俄亥俄州哥倫布、印第安納州印第安納波利斯與加州聖地牙哥航線，每日1班，其中聖地牙哥航線設有Mint平躺商務艙。捷藍明顯鎖定精神航空今年5月停運後留下的市場：精神航空停運前是美國在哥倫比亞營運最大的航空公司，自勞德岱堡飛往7個哥倫比亞城市；捷藍在其停運僅2日後，即宣布開航巴蘭基亞與卡利。在此之前，7月捷藍亦自勞德岱堡新增8條航線，包括每日飛往巴爾的摩／華盛頓、夏洛特、芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）、休士頓、納許維爾與波多黎各龐塞。

en.title: JetBlue makes Fort Lauderdale its busiest airport as 8 new routes lift winter flights 57%
en.summary: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood has overtaken New York JFK and Boston as JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, with more than 150 daily departures at peak this winter; the airline has added eight new routes from the South Florida airport, moving into markets left by Spirit Airlines' shutdown.
body: According to schedule data from aviation analytics provider Cirium, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) is now JetBlue Airways' busiest airport by scheduled departures, overtaking John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and Boston Logan International Airport (BOS). During peak periods this winter, the airline expects to offer more than 150 daily departures, its largest schedule ever at the airport. It has scheduled more than 3,900 flights from the airport this month, up about 57% from November last year, and about 21,500 departures for the winter 2026/27 season, up from nearly 13,700 the previous winter, with nonstop destinations growing from 47 to 62.

JetBlue recently announced two new daily nonstop international routes from Fort Lauderdale: Comayagua, Honduras, from February 25, 2027, and George Town, Cayman Islands, from February 23, 2027. Comayagua will be an entirely new destination for the airline and its second in Honduras, bringing its international network from Fort Lauderdale to 20 destinations. The airline will also fly daily nonstop to Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago, from January 29 through February 15, 2027, to serve demand around the Trinidad and Tobago Carnival.

JetBlue launched daily services to Barranquilla, Colombia, on October 1, 2026, and Cali, Colombia, on October 15, and added daily nonstop flights to Columbus, Ohio, Indianapolis, Indiana, and San Diego, California, this month — San Diego features the Mint lie-flat business class cabin on the cross-country route. The expansion targets former Spirit Airlines markets: before ceasing operations in May, Spirit was the largest US airline operating in Colombia, serving seven cities from Fort Lauderdale, and JetBlue announced the Barranquilla and Cali services just two days after the shutdown. In July alone, JetBlue launched eight further routes from Fort Lauderdale, including daily services to Baltimore/Washington, Charlotte, Chicago O'Hare (ORD), Houston, Nashville and Ponce, Puerto Rico.

facts.claim: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood is now JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, overtaking JFK and Boston, with more than 150 daily departures at peak this winter.
JetBlue has scheduled more than 3,900 flights from Fort Lauderdale this month, up about 57% from November last year, and about 21,500 departures for winter 2026/27, up from nearly 13,700.

JetBlue announced daily nonstop routes from Fort Lauderdale to Comayagua from February 25, 2027, and George Town from February 23, 2027, plus daily Port of Spain flights from January 29 through February 15, 2027.

JetBlue added daily services to Barranquilla on October 1, 2026, Cali on October 15, and Columbus, Indianapolis and San Diego in November, moving into markets Spirit served before ceasing operations in May.
